segments.name: Safety equipment
segments.description: Provides safety equipment, industrial hardware and clean-energy solutions to customers in infrastructure, building construction, marine, oil and gas industries.
segments.evidence: Our business is principally involved in the provision of safety equipment, encompassing essential items such as (i) personal protective clothing, hand gloves, safety footwear, and personal fall arrest systems

revenueModel.text: Customers, mainly in Singapore and Southeast Asia, pay the company for sales of safety equipment and auxiliary products, service income and equipment rental.
revenueModel.evidence: For the financial year ended March 31, 2026, our 3 categories of revenue were (i) safety equipment and auxiliary product, (ii) service income and (iii) rental of equipment, which accounted for S$50.1 million, S$1.0 million and S$0.1 million respectively.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026 the company consolidated safety equipment and hardware products sale revenue into one group.
changes.evidence: For the financial year ended March 31, 2026, we consolidated the revenue for safety equipment and hardware products sale revenue as one group which is 98.0% of the total revenue.
